transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function whose body preserves the Rust 1.96 target shape `let (m, n) = (self.len(), needle.len()); m >= n && needle == &self[m - n..]`, adapted only by naming the receiver parameter `slice` and isolating the suffix comparison as a named source-backed boundary.

Modeled the second conjunct `needle == &slice[m - n..]` as target-local `rust_1_96_needle_eq_slice_suffix`, carrying only the generated suffix relation when the Rust length guard establishes `n <= m`. This records the frozen slice range expression plus the slice PartialEq / SlicePartialEq::equal_same_length implementation without externalizing the public target.

Added the generated `slice_is_suffix` / `partial_eq_observed` vocabulary as the Verus ensures clause on the target and the narrow suffix-comparison boundary; this records the contract under test and does not use assume_specification.
